title: YouTube market_narrative is look-ahead leakage on NBA + POL sim-dated TFs
impact: Every NBA TF LLM call since 2026-04-20 for games dated <= 2026-04-19 has seen future-relative YouTube content. Any WR uptick on recent sim runs must be considered contaminated.
mitigation_applied: 2026-04-21T12:35Z: stripped market_narrative from NBA+POL in data/prompts/overrides.json
ITF + PQTF retain narrative (both live-trade current date, no look-ahead)
NBA+POL keep flag market_narrative_disabled with reason for re-enable

required_fix.change: Filter videos by published_at <= sim_date. Only enable market_narrative for fleets where sim_date == live_date (ITF, PQTF).
required_fix.re_enable_after: fix deployed, audit confirms published_at <= sim_date for all injected videos
